## The problem

What are you trying to do that Kuki OSS doesn't support well today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? Describe behavior, not implementation.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I'd like to work on this myself
- [ ] I'm only suggesting it

Note: features that belong to Kuki Core (cross-tenant aggregation, ML
ranking) are out of scope for this repository. See
[What's Not Included](https://docs.kuki.co.ke/architecture/whats-not-included).
